• Eight new data centre and lab planning or design tenders are available this week, including technical design, feasibility, advisory, and construction projects.
• Available opportunities include the Technical Design and Feasibility for New Data Center and New Data Center Construction in Palmanova.
• BD can pursue the Design Consultancy for Regional Data Centre Upgrade and Client Advisory Consultancy for New Data Centre Construction.
• Additional tenders include Engineering Design Services for Lille Regional Data Centre and general planning for data centre renovation.
• Remaining opportunities are general planning for a new data centre and lab building, plus AI data centre construction.
